title: pixel purge
pitch: crash's pictures got corrupted. load floppy-disk turrets onto a 5-slot bench and shoot every pixel back into place. fill the bench and you're cooked.
controls: tap / click a floppy (keys 1-3), z = ctrl+z, r = restart. badges show how many pixels each front disk can hit.
changelog: v2: wake chains (idle disks firing again within 3s build a combo), per-lane hit-count badges, 3 stars per level (clear, no undo, low bench), daily counts first try only, bench stays visible on the lose card, timer pauses in menus, warning re-arms, shorter tutorial.
how_to: tap a floppy with a number badge: it shoots the lowest pixel of its color in each column, so clear from the bottom up.
the badge is how many pixels that front disk can hit right now. sleepy disks have nothing to shoot yet.
empty disks leave. anything with shots left sits on the 5-slot bench, and a full bench means you are cooked.
z is ctrl+z: one undo per level. save it for when the bench is nearly full.
the daily picture is the same for everyone, and only your first try counts.
